product.title: DEWALT 20V Max Cordless Drill Driver Set, 2 Speed, High Performance Motor, Includes 2 XR 1.3Ah Li-Ion Batteries, Charger and Contractor Bag (DCD771C2)

reviews.reviewDescription: Excellent cordless drill set for a woman who wants to do her own minor home projects without asking for help! Easy to use and smooth operation. Versatile in switching between screwing or drilling. Heavy enough impact to do everything I’ve asked it to. Two batteries and a charger included. Cute and convenient carrying case! Want to hang pictures? Drill some holes? No problem!
reviews.author: AGMPMGUYCPVWUCXHVYGFT5IL2MVQ

reviews.reviewDescription: I love this drill. The price was great. I really like the bag and having 2 batteries.
reviews.author: AHIMUK6YP5HKUT3AP2SWAGUOUGBQ

reviews.reviewDescription: Love my DeWalt!! Works great. Plenty of power, LED light is bright, has a feel of quality to it...that my budget drill DID NOT have. I've used it on a few projects so far...& it works great. DeWalt is a well known company that's been around for a long time. The case is great to have...& it's nice having a 2nd battery ready to use. I also purchased a Dewalt drill bit set & screwdriver bit set, & they are top quality as well.
reviews.author: AHSHQY25U3ACPOXQORK7K26EEKOA

reviews.reviewDescription: Well worth the purchase and really good price . Nice carrying case operates as it should . Would purchase again in the future if come across some more good deals .
reviews.author: AFVH7W7HMJWWYHTW5A3M427ZQSRA

reviews.reviewDescription: DEWALT products are always good quality and this drill is no exception. I love that it comes with a nice, convenient storage case, a charger, and two batteries. It fits nicely in the hand and even has a torque setting for the screwdriver function. This drill is definitely a great addition to my home/work shop and is replacing four older drills that no longer work well.
reviews.author: AH6X3D3QZGOM24ST2AE3NE6PMTPA

reviews.reviewDescription: Good product. Sometimes the drill stalls out. Don’t know if it’s a mfg defect. Works 97% of time well love the dual battery.
reviews.author: AE7FSDEOUXNDOZ53N5F65L2I4SUQ

reviews.reviewDescription: Great product. My cordless drill made by another major manufacturer got stolen and I decided to change platforms and go with Dewalt. I can't say it was better than my other drill but it is just as good. If you need a great drill that will do a lot of work and last, this is a good choice. If you only need to use one occasionally, you might be able to get by with a less expensive alternative. Dewalt batteries are expensive but they are great products and worth the price. I also like the bag that came with it as there is room in it for other items as well.
reviews.author: AF532RMFTE3MAQAKIWCZ3YUKOZ2A

reviews.reviewDescription: Very good quality drill. It's portable and powerful. Good value for the amount that I paid for it.
reviews.author: AG45PT6XOTCQGQD3SNZII364NRRQ
